shared_elements: single upright anthropomorphic figure shown frontally
head with distinct headgear/crown-like element at top
arms bent with hands brought to the chest
banded or striated surface areas across the lower body
justification: Both present a single centred, frontal upright figure with a marked head element above and arms folded toward the chest, and both include concentric ring/disc motifs, though in A the big rayed disc crowns the head while in B the ring sits on the torso. The overwhelming difference is manner: A is a crisp, flat, brightly coloured graphic with outlined limbs, feathers and textiles, while B is a mass of weathered stone whose forms are shallow, eroded relief with almost no articulation of limbs or costume.
